name: theorist
title_zh: 每次会话都重写一遍的 THEORY.MD
tagline_zh: 代码在改，但没人说得清为什么这么改。它逼你把背后的假设写成一篇连贯叙事，每次有新结果。
tagline_en: Code changes, but nobody can say why. It forces the assumptions behind the work into one living narrative.
desc_en: Maintain a per-repo THEORY.MD as a continuously updated narrative of the operating theory behind the current work. Activates EVERY session and stays active throughout the session. Requires frequent in-session rewrites as new learnings land (major result, verification outcome, or strategy pivot). Not a log, not a plan, not a todo list — a cohesive document describing the higher-level thinking, syst
why_zh: 它把「当前在赌什么」当成一等公民：每会话激活、随新证据重写，而不是攒成流水账。
why_en: It treats 'what are we betting on' as a first-class artifact: active every session, rewritten as evidence lands, never a running.
limit_zh: 它只写 THEORY.MD 这一个文件，不碰代码、不跑测试、不替你验证假设真假。
limit_en: Writes only THEORY.MD — no code, no tests, no validation. You decide what counts as a rewrite-worthy result; guess wrong and it rots into stale docs.
title_en: A THEORY.MD rewritten every session to say what the work.
